method: Separate freshness effects from predecessor-specific effects before promoting a temporal connection.

connections.name: FRESHNESS_IS_A_CONFOUNDER_FOR_TEMPORAL_REWIRE
connections.observation: A temporal rewire can accidentally create a stale state; loss of successor eligibility could then be caused by freshness rather than by breaking the predecessor edge.
connections.claim_ceiling: Methodological confound identified; no causal conclusion yet.

connections.name: PREDECESSOR_SPECIFICITY_REQUIRES_FRESHNESS_CONTROL
connections.observation: To attribute successor loss to a specific predecessor relation, the rewired record must remain freshness-equivalent to the real record.
connections.testable_prediction: A valid predecessor-specific effect survives freshness-only manipulation but collapses under relation rewiring.

connections.name: SUCCESSOR_ELIGIBILITY_HAS_TWO_FACTORS
connections.mechanism: predecessor relation + freshness state -> successor eligibility
connections.observation: Temporal continuity and historical dependence are distinct dimensions and must be modeled separately.

connections.name: AUTHENTICITY_CURRENTNESS_AND_CAUSAL_DEPENDENCE_ARE_DISTINCT
connections.observation: A record can be authentic, current, or causally linked to its predecessor as separate properties; one does not prove the others.

connections.name: FRESHNESS_ONLY_NULL_IS_REQUIRED
connections.observation: A null that destroys both temporal relation and freshness cannot discriminate the proposed edge from a generic stale-state failure.
connections.required_control: Preserve freshness while breaking predecessor-successor assignment.

edge_survival_matrix_v2.interpretation: The fifth state is a confounder control. If a candidate fails under both TEMPORAL_REWIRED and FRESHNESS_ONLY_SHUFFLE it is not predecessor-specific; if it survives FRESHNESS_ONLY_SHUFFLE but fails under TEMPORAL_REWIRED it is a stronger predecessor-specific candidate.

rewiring_requirements: preserve schema and local structural statistics
negative_controls: Do not treat signatures or hashes as proof of currentness.
Do not treat repeated parent-child lineage as independent cross-domain evidence.
Do not promote a temporal connection from a rewiring that also changes freshness.
next_gate: Execute the five-state matrix on matched records and compare continuous effect sizes against a schema-matched null distribution.
